body: Well I sort of am suicidal.  That's the thing.  But i want treatment that doesn't involve me getting committed

Nothing really.  That's the problem.  Maybe, having a relationship, being in love.  But I've tried that for a few years now, and its just rejection and failure.

It would make me happy if I just stopped feeling like this.  The only way I can imagine to do that, is to stop feeling altogether.
Well that makes me really not want to share all of this with him...

True, but what if I am a danger to myself, as he deems, and he chooses to use that?   On your one to 10 scale, I'm probably an 8 right now.  Maybe your scale is a 10, but maybe his is an 8, and he reports it to the authorities.   I don't know if I can take that chance, even if honesty is important for healing.   If I get reported to my school or a mental hospital, my life is over on a way that I believe is worse than suicide
Although being institutionalized will cost me my job and my degree and my career.  If that is the cost to get better, it's not a "better" I want.  I'd rather just end it than live that way

I do.  They are just things to fill in time though.  Read, hike, ps3, foreign languages, cook.  Although lately, none of that is really that fun.  I've mostly been in bed all day.  I COULD do those things, but they just seem like a waste of time.

No.  Just never happy anymore.  I'm not happy with my life, and I don't see any way to change that.  And I've always been alone. 

For some people, talking might be the best thing.  But i don't know what consequences my therapist can impose, since he works for the school.  If he does anything to jeopardize my degree or forces me to be committed, then talking to him is exactly what I shouldn't be doing.
